notice: Entirely invented demonstration records. No patient, call, or third-party dataset is used.

generation.scope: Illustrative volumes and distributions, not empirical service assumptions.
generation.shift_scope: Only A/P1 dispatched September 21-30; only arrival timestamps can differ.
generation.coupling: One latent uniform draw and both candidate durations per row are shared by stable and shift.
generation.seed_policy: Seed fixed before inspection; retain any naturally occurring false alarms.
generation.edge_policy: Deterministic hand-counted fixtures; random generation rules do not apply to edge_cases.csv.

stable.csv.description: Unchanged generating conditions; false alarms remain possible.

zone_shift.csv.description: Same baseline and all other records; A/P1 monitoring probability rises to .35.

edge_cases.csv.description: Boundary, sparse, degenerate, current-day, new-zone, and invalid-row fixtures.
edge_cases.csv.priority_note: P2 appears only on one excluded duplicate copy; selecting P2 returns empty analysis with coverage.
